mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}AND dataset=#{dataset}AND batch_id=#{batchId}

SELECT id,batch_id,case_id,case_snapshot,run_id,conversation_id,status,plan_correct,tool_correct,rag_hit,cited_count,correct_cited_count,refused,refusal_correct,costs_json,unknown_cost_calls,answer,error_message,create_time* FROM WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}AND dataset=#{dataset}AND batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY next_run_at DESCcreate_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT resource_type,resource_key,version_id FROM ai_execution_release WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY resource_type,resource_key
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_case SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM ai_eval_case c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.dataset=#{dataset} AND c.enabled=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_eval_case newer WHERE newer.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND newer.dataset=c.dataset AND newer.case_key=c.case_key AND newer.version>c.version) ORDER BY c.case_key LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_resource_version WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND resource_type=#{type} AND resource_key=#{key} AND status<>'REJECTED'
SELECT config_json FROM ai_resource_version WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND resource_type=#{type} AND resource_key=#{key}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_eval_batch WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(status='SUCCEEDED') AS succeeded,SUM(status='FAILED') AS failed,SUM(status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')) AS completed,AVG(plan_correct) AS planning_accuracy,AVG(tool_correct) AS tool_accuracy,AVG(rag_hit) AS rag_hit_rate,SUM(cited_count) AS cited_count,SUM(correct_cited_count) AS correct_cited_count,SUM(correct_cited_count)/NULLIF(SUM(cited_count),0) AS citation_correctness,AVG(refused) AS refusal_rate,AVG(refusal_correct) AS refusal_accuracy,SUM(unknown_cost_calls) AS unknown_cost_calls FROM ai_eval_result WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_model_call_log l JOIN ai_eval_result e ON e.run_id=l.run_id AND e.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE e.batch_id=#{id} AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.estimated_cost IS NULL

SELECT l.currency,SUM(l.estimated_cost) AS amount FROM ai_model_call_log l JOIN ai_eval_result e ON e.run_id=l.run_id AND e.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE e.batch_id=#{id} AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.estimated_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.currency

SELECT DISTINCT v.resource_type,v.resource_key,v.version_id FROM ai_execution_release v JOIN ai_eval_result e ON e.run_id=v.run_id AND e.tenant_id=v.tenant_id WHERE e.batch_id=#{id} AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY v.resource_type,v.resource_key,v.version_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_schedule(tenant_id,dataset,interval_hours,enabled,user_id,session_id,next_run_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{dataset},#{hours},#{enabled},#{userId},#{sessionId},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE interval_hours=VALUES(interval_hours),enabled=VALUES(enabled),user_id=VALUES(user_id),session_id=VALUES(session_id),next_run_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL
mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM ai_eval_result e WHERE e.status='PENDING' ORDER BY e.create_time,e.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM ai_eval_batch WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task_run SET run_type='EVALUATION' WHERE run_id=#{runId}
UPDATE ai_eval_batch SET status='RUNNING' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE ai_eval_result SET status='FAILED',plan_correct=0,tool_correct=0,error_message=#{message} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT e.*,b.model_alias FROM ai_eval_result e JOIN ai_eval_batch b ON b.id=e.batch_id WHERE e.status='RUNNING' ORDER BY e.create_time LIMIT 200
SELECT status,plan_json,start_time FROM ai_task_run WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_batch b SET b.status=IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_eval_result e WHERE e.batch_id=b.id AND e.status='FAILED'),'FAILED','SUCCEEDED'),b.finish_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE b.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_eval_result e WHERE e.batch_id=b.id AND e.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'))
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM ai_chat_message WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND role='assistant'
SELECT sources_json FROM ai_run_sources WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId}
SELECT currency,SUM(estimated_cost) AS amount FROM ai_model_call_log WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND estimated_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY currency
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_model_call_log WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND estimated_cost IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_result SET status=#{status},plan_correct=#{plan},tool_correct=#{tools},rag_hit=#{rag},cited_count=#{cited},correct_cited_count=#{correct},refused=#{refused},refusal_correct=#{refusalCorrect},costs_json=#{costs},unknown_cost_calls=#{unknown},answer=#{answer},error_message=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_eval_schedule WHERE enabled=1 AND next_run_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_run_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_schedule SET next_run_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL interval_hours HOUR) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dataset=#{dataset}
UPDATE ai_eval_schedule SET enabled=0,last_error=#{message} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dataset=#{dataset}
